title: Capture golden state
summary: Capture a new golden through the governed operation to seal current cause-bearing probes. On macOS it first asks a running Safari to quit and waits for it, never force-quitting, so Safari's state is on disk; Linux and WSL capture does the same for the desktop Chromium, refusing test_machine_sign_in_app_quit_not_proved when it stays open; macOS harness logins, browser identities and Safari's cookie store stay outside the archive. Saving a completed harness sign-in is this same capture. Required Linux teaching also excludes desktop Chromium sign-ins from every golden and preserves the existing ~/snap/chromium/common/chromium store only when present after Chromium quits; an older golden must never restore stale browser sign-in state. The unmerged producer commit 5a4b84c0d7565f38cc2308df25950fd76d4fef0e implements the snap-store exclusion and conditional carry-forward in source. Producer-reported evidence is 29 targeted checks passing, CI run 39040788218 passing, and QA requirement 50631 artifact 36759. These are candidate source checks, not merged delivery or real reset/sign-in proof; those remain pending. Observed status covers source observations, not live verification. Capture refuses golden_capture_insufficient_space before writing when the destination filesystem cannot hold the home, and after the new golden is registered it deletes every retired snapshot except that golden and its probes and manifest. An undeclared nonzero probe exit retries once with both attempts retained; a declared failure stops immediately.
